scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run db:seed:demo && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"

scripts.setup:python: echo 'Creating Python venv...' && python3.12 -m venv backend/.venv && echo 'Installing Python dependencies...' && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run setup:python && npm run db:up && sleep 2 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
